name: Aokie Speech to Text
description: Dedicated speech-to-text service backed by the Aokie voice stack (aokie-voice-server.exe --mode stt) — transcription only, exposed as an OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint (POST /v1/audio/transcriptions) on a loopback port for FormLogic Flows' Transcribe audio step and the receptionist's STT source picker. The server binary ships with the Aokie plugin (aokie-voice-server.exe next to aokie-plugin.exe); install the Aokie plugin in the Plugins tab first. Default engine is NVIDIA Parakeet ONNX; swap engines without editing this template via the card's Extra args — e.g. "--stt-engine moonshine" or "--stt-engine qwen3-asr", plus "--stt-model-dir DIR" to point at a specific model folder. The model loads lazily on first request (~600 MB RAM).
